tables.title: TABLE VI. - OVERALL PERFORMANCE FOR STAGE 52-52 (a) 70 Percent design speed
tables.notes: Readings 2221, 2222, 2224, 2225. Columns = readings in printed order under the group heading 'Reading' (high to low flow); first column = parameter labels as printed. No units printed and no units row (row 2 blank); appendix C: WT FLOW = equivalent weight flow, kg/sec; per-area flows kg/(sec)(m2); ROTATIVE SPEED rpm. Stage with the stators at the 2-chord position (pdf p8). First read at 300 dpi; second read of every '?' cell and of cells failing the checks at 600-1200 dpi. Checks: efficiencies from the pressure and temperature ratios, annulus/frontal flow ratio, orifice/frontal flow ratio, rotative speed/percent speed, head-rise coefficient scaled by speed squared; see notes.md.

tables.title: TABLE VII. - Continued. BLADE-ELEMENT DATA AT BLADE EDGES FOR ROTOR 52 (o) 100 Percent design speed; reading 2217
tables.notes: Four printed blocks joined side by side on RP; headings = printed group heading + sub-heading. Only RP 1-9 printed (no TIP/HUB rows). No units row printed (row 2 blank); appendix C: radii cm, angles deg, TEMP K, PRESS N/cm2, VEL and SPEED m/sec. Numbers kept as printed (signed zeros '-0.0'). Stators at the 2-chord position. Read cell by cell from native-resolution (300 dpi) crops of each block, suspect cells zoomed further; pdftotext layer not used for numbers. Checks: velocity triangles, Mach-number ratios, MERID VEL R, EFF from the pressure and temperature ratios, U/r against the Table VI rotative speed; blade angles implied by INCIDENCE/DEV agree with the geometry table and across the five readings. See notes.md.
